headline: Quarterly growth is uneven, with AI‑led firms outpacing traditional players.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributions are highlighted across most firms, boosting margins for some but not all. Dividend payouts remain modest, and guidance is mixed, with Infosys trimming outlook and others holding steady. Profitability improved for HCLTech and Coforge, while Wipro and Persistent saw declines.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms cite AI as a key growth driver, with AI revenue up 29% at Infosys and 47% at LTM.

themes.title: Margin expansion pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins improved for high‑growth firms like Coforge but lagged for low‑growth players.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or modestly raised interim dividends despite mixed earnings.
